translation_pair.general_comprehension: Think of the Sovereign system as an automated blood test interpreter with a built-in safety referee. When it analysed the patient's vascular data, it found that the blood oxygen readings (Node N7) looked reassuringly normal — but this was masking a hidden problem upstream. Like a smoke detector going off in the basement while the fire actually started in the garage, the system traced the real source back to elevated triglyceride levels (Node N3) quietly raising artery resistance (Node N5) before the oxygen sensors could show the damage. Two internal software bugs that could have caused the safety pause mechanism itself to crash have now been fixed. Overall, the system is operating at 87% compliance, the two bugs are resolved, and the AI correctly flagged a real health risk that a simple oxygen reading might have hidden.
